premises.text: Searching for products online can be frustrating and time-consuming
premises.evidence_span: I was extremely frustrated from the searching and shopping experience.

premises.text: Users struggle to find visual products using traditional search methods
premises.evidence_span: it was very difficult to put in words a visual product that I had in mind, and I got a lot of unrelated results.

premises.text: Donde can help users find products quickly and accurately
premises.evidence_span: With Donde, you can find exactly what you're looking for in less than 15 seconds.

premises.text: The app personalizes search results based on user context and preferences
premises.evidence_span: It's based on a learning mechanism that combines the contextual information of the search of the user, and her location, her age, everything that we can know about her taste and her environment.

premises.text: The technology uses data scraping and ontology creation to enhance search accuracy
premises.evidence_span: we're scraping the data of different websites and different stores, extracting the unique fingerprints of every item, and using and creating an ontology, a common language of all the brands and all the retailers.

premises.text: Artificial intelligence is used to optimize the search process
premises.evidence_span: using an artificial intelligence technology to choose the best question to ask you next.

value.text: Users experience a delightful and seamless product search
value.evidence_span: we offer a very intuitive and delightful search experience for everyone.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
